pr_title: Add Grid import export to Enphase Envoy
pr_body:
<!--

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

Implement net consumption (grid import) and  net production (grid export) for Enphase envoy metered with installed and configured CT.

Added sensor entities:

- `Envoy current net power consumption`   (positive/negative grid power exchange)
- `Envoy lifetime net energy consumption`  (grid energy import)
- `Envoy lifetime net energy production`  (grid energy export)

In the energy dashboard one can use  `Envoy lifetime net energy consumption` for `Grid consumption` and `Envoy lifetime net energy production` for `Return to grid`.

These entities are also available for phases if more then 1 phase is configured in the Envoy.

Also added as disabled by integration, user can enable as needed:

- `Envoy Frequency net consumption ct` (grid frequency)
- `Envoy Voltage net consumption ct` (grid voltage)
- `Envoy Metering status net consumption CT`
- `Envoy Meter status flags active net consumption ct`
- `Envoy Metering status production CT`
- `Envoy Meter status flags active production CT`

issue_context.title: Current power consumption and production are not shown as long term statistics
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The two **Envoy _nnnn_ Current Power Consumption** and **Production** entities of the Enphase Envoy integration are not shown in the energy dashboard when selecting the sources. Only the Last Seven Days, Lifetime and Today's Energy Production/Consumption can be selected.

The entity attributes are the following:
`sensor.envoy_nnnnnnnnnn _current_power_consumption`:
```
state: 2488
state_class: measurement
unit_of_measurement: W
icon: mdi:flash
friendly_name: Envoy nnnnnnnnnn Current Power Consumption
```

`sensor.envoy_nnnnnnnnnn_current_power_production`:
```
state: -3
state_class: measurement
unit_of_measurement: W
icon: mdi:flash
friendly_name: Envoy nnnnnnnnnn Current Power Production
```

The state class of the entities that are shown (and selectable) is `total_increasing`:
`sensor.envoy_nnnnnnnnnn_last_seven_days_energy_consumption`
```
state_class: total_increasing
unit_of_measurement: Wh
device_class: energy
icon: mdi:flash
friendly_name: Envoy nnnnnnnnnn Last Seven Days Energy Consumption
```

See: https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/sensor#long-term-statistics.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.11.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

enphase_envoy

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/enphase_envoy

### Diagnostics information

[config_entry-enphase_envoy-104742ceab5a4a3c9bb75986b26427c0.json.txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/10106877/config_entry-enphase_envoy-104742ceab5a4a3c9bb75986b26427c0.json.txt)


### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

The Envoy Gateway is an Envoy-S-Metered-EM:
* **SKU**: ENV-S-WM-230
* **Firmware**: D5.0.55

I found this workaround [Enhpase Envoy on 2021.8 with new Energy feature](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/enhpase-envoy-on-2021-8-with-new-energy-feature/328668) from [this other issue comment](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/issues/22696#issuecomment-1123274433)

>  Only the Last Seven Days, Lifetime and Today's Energy Production/Consumption can be selected.


I'm not following the issue, but you should be using lifetime? Why would you use current?

The integration provides the following sensors that can be used with the Energy dashboard:
```
sensor.envoy_<serialnumber>_last_seven_days_energy_consumption
sensor.envoy_<serialnumber>_last_seven_days_energy_production
sensor.envoy_<serialnumber>_lifetime_energy_consumption
sensor.envoy_<serialnumber>_lifetime_energy_production
sensor.envoy_<serialnumber>_today_s_energy_consumption

```

And the following that can not be used:
```
sensor.envoy_<serialnumber>_current_power_consumption
sensor.envoy_<serialnumber>_current_power_production
```

You are right, I can use _lifetime_ for _grid consumption_, _today's_ for _production_, but I don't know how to configure _return to grid_. I don't have a sensor with this information:
* *Grid consumption*: `sensor.envoy_<serialnumber>_lifetime_energy_consumption`
* *Return to grid*: (?)
* *Solar production*: `sensor.envoy_<serialnumber>_today_s_energy_production`

I know that this information should be available, because the Enlighten Enphase web app and Android application displays this to me:

![Enlighten](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12809819/205356843-0207cee9-76de-42e1-b0ee-268f0ecdec88.PNG)

And this is what the [Enhpase Envoy on 2021.8 with new Energy feature](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/enhpase-envoy-on-2021-8-with-new-energy-feature/328668) post workarounds.

The instantaneous consumption/production is power, measured in Watt (W). The energy dashboard reports only on energy, measured in Watt hour (Wh). To show the instantaneous production and consumption you need another tool than the Energy dashboard, for example the custom:power-flow-card provided through HACS.

+1

Would like to see this also.

Are we clear about the question here? Scanning through all the comments and references it seems the ask is about

 `net energy consumption` (grid energy import) and `net energy production` (grid energy export) that can be added to the energy dashboard for `grid consumption` and `return to grid`. 

Or is the ask for power import and export, which can not be added to the energy dashboard as @rrozema mentions. 

Since both come from same source, the consumption CT installed in Solar included mode, both can be provided from the ivp/meters/readings endpoint. I have started the migration of the data collection logic from [@briancmpbll's custom integration](https://github.com/briancmpbll/home_assistant_custom_envoy) to [pyenphase](https://github.com/pyenphase/pyenphase/issues/69) which is now the source for HA. Once that is available in pyenphase, it can be added to the HA Enphase_Envoy as well.

As said, this will only work for Envoy metered with installed and configured CT and the consumption CT measuring the grid exchange (Solar included) mode.

> `net energy consumption` (grid energy import) and `net energy production` (grid energy export) that can be added to the energy dashboard for `grid consumption` and `return to grid`.

That's exactly the issue. As I've mentioned in the description, now some of us are workarounding this by using the proposal mentioned in this community thread [Enphase Envoy with Energy Dashboard](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/enphase-envoy-with-energy-dashboard/328668). 

Thanks for your work :-)
